articles.title: N-able Takes N-central Servers Offline Worldwide After 33 0-Day Vulnerabilities and Able2Shell Exploits
articles.summary:
N-able took its hosted N-central environments offline on November 9, 2026, after an independent researcher published details of 33 alleged zero-day vulnerabilities and exploit code. The company also told customers running N-central on their own servers to take them offline until further notice, creating an outage for users of its remote monitoring and management platform. […]

articles.title: CISA Warns of SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks
